title: Mediation Act
lead: ==‘The Mediation Act was the first step in consolidating Gandhi's civilisational legacy’ — President Murmu.== India's Mediation Association and first mediation conference were launched in ==May 2025==.

items: ==Judicial efficiency== — mandatory pre-litigation mediation for civil/commercial disputes (excluding urgent interim relief)
==International alignment== — the ==Singapore Convention==; subsuming ‘conciliation’ under ‘mediation’; recognising online/community mediation
==Economic growth== — positioning India as a ==hub for domestic and international mediation==

items.title: Scope & Application
bullets: ==Mandatory pre-litigation mediation== for civil/commercial suits unless urgent interim relief is sought
==International mediation==: conducted in India with at least one ==foreign national/entity== party
==Exclusions==: minors, deities, criminal prosecutions, tax matters and others in the ==First Schedule==

items.title: Process Framework
bullets: ==Enforcement==: mediated agreements enforceable ==as court decrees== under the CPC, 1908

items.title: Institutional Mechanisms
bullets: ==Mediation Council of India (MCI)== — registration, accreditation, ethical standards
==Mediation Service Providers== — court-annexed centres, legal services authorities, notified bodies

items.title: Amendments to Existing Laws
bullets: ==Overrides conciliation provisions== of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
Amends the ==Indian Contract Act, 1872== and ==CPC, 1908== to reference mediation

items.title: Issues
bullets: ==Implementation gaps== — voluntary vs mandatory; registration of settlements
==Exclusion of key disputes== — government entities; ==cross-border gaps==

items.title: Solutions
bullets: ==Clarifying rules==: define interim-relief powers, adopt ==conflict-of-interest guidelines==, mandate registration

blocks.text: Mediation offers resolution, not retaliation. But unless it's empowered with trust, structure and wider acceptance, it risks becoming the most underused tool in a system desperate for alternatives.
